She got knocked out, and she still said she was the best.

Kevin Trudeau tells of an MMA fighter who stood in her corner repeating "I'm the best." Then she got knocked out. Afterward she said it wasn't her best outing, but she learned something and would get better.

She came back the next fight, repeated it, and won. Then she went on to win the whole string.

Kevin calls that the attitude of a champion: feed the belief, learn from the loss, go again.

How do you talk to yourself after a setback?

#ad #confidence #success #kevintrudeau

He yelled at his manager, then leaned back and smiled.

Kevin Trudeau tells how, early in his career, he went into the homes of very wealthy men and watched them through their day. One looked at his numbers and shouted that they sucked, then called a manager and warned him he was seconds from being fired.

Then the manager left, and the man leaned back with a big smile. Kevin could see him picturing the numbers going up and feeling good.

Kevin's takeaway: he used the energy to get the guy moving, then switched to feeling good.

When did you last use frustration to start something?
